Hetwane Dam.subject: Indian Heritage
Hetwane Dam.question: The _____ was Dam in Pen.
Hetwane Dam.fact: Hetwane Dam, is an earthfill dam on Bhogeshwari river near Pen, Raigad district in the state of Maharashtra in India. Hetwane dam was constructed by Maharashtra Master Construction.
